comparison.objective: Fit left- and right-handed hinge brackets into their corresponding pockets; no detailed body or specs available.
comparison.physical_skill: Handed-part discrimination, orientation, and pocket insertion versus coaxial mandrel alignment, hammering, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Each bracket seated in the correct handed pocket versus four tang removals with insert retention and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Shared fine alignment does not erase the different tested ability: handed insertion rather than controlled fracture. Seating and tolerance rubrics are missing.
